phase.title: Configure the orchestration pilot and shared policy

summary: Configured the orchestration Renovate pilot: shared preset, root config, dependency annotations, official validator workflow, canonical policy/ownership links, and coverage report. Corrected the workflow’s npx invocation so the validator binary runs explicitly. Validation passed under Node 24.20.0: strict validation of both configs, local extraction/lookup (98 occurrences across 34 files; 101 candidate branches), actionlint, bash -n, ShellCheck, diff checks, static security guardrails, and guardrail self-tests. Dependency versions and digests remain unchanged. Policy preserves digest pinning, first-party release ownership, ARM64/checksum review, approval gates, and unrestricted security scheduling. GitHub-authenticated lookups, published-preset resolution, hosted full dry-run evidence, scanner evidence, and anonymous Docker-token retry gaps remain explicitly deferred to later phases. Handoff references: docs/dependency-automation.md and docs/research/dependency-automation-coverage.md.
